scope: Reviewed corrections to ENTSO-E unit fuel labels (A73 psrType) for coal (B02, B03, B05). Each record applies to the rows of one unit whose UTC month lies in [from_month, to_month] (to_month null: open-ended) and whose psrType is source_psr. exclude: coal rows that are not coal (dropped from the rebuild payload and from every load). count_as_coal: a non-coal series that is coal for the tracker; the certified rebuild writes it as counted_psr, and every load drops its source_psr rows in the window, since those months come only from the rebuild. reviewed_names: the names its rows carry without a unit EIC (legacy rows), matched only for this record. Loaded and validated by src/entsoe_fuel_exceptions.py. Decisions: chienleng/global-coal-generation-tracker#48 and #10.

exceptions.reason: München Nord 2. ENTSO-E now labels the unit's whole history as gas (B04); it was hard coal (B05) in the February 2026 download, GEM has the unit as coal until its 2024 conversion, and ENTSO-E's A75 country totals still count these years as coal.
